content.comment_body: Hello, I'm beginning to learn [company_name] [product_name] modules and plan to move on to [product_name] PLCs later. I'm having trouble understanding how to organize the bits and knowing their applications. I searched online for courses, but most are expensive (around 8,000 rand or more) and focused on [product_name] PLCs, while I need basic training with the [product_name] module first. Can anyone recommend affordable courses or share tips for learning this in a structured way? Thank you.

Welcome to the forum. For a start, try these resources: Easy Entry in [product_name], [product_name] application examples, tips and tricks (video), and [product_name] web-based trainings. These links provide helpful material for beginners.

analysis.insight_summary: Individuals looking to learn the basics of [product_name] modules and PLCs from [company_name] are finding it challenging to locate entry-level, affordable training options. Official resources for self-learning are suggested, but there is a noticeable gap in cost-effective, beginner-focused, structured courses, especially for those wanting to start with [product_name] modules before progressing to PLCs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to find accessible and budget-friendly courses or resources that teach [product_name] modules step-by-step, making it easier for beginners to build foundational knowledge before moving on to advanced PLC systems.
